tasks.label: RustPLC: scenario-init (normal)
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- scenario-init plc/main.plc --preset normal --out scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml

tasks.label: RustPLC: scenario-validate
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- scenario-validate plc/main.plc --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --output human

tasks.label: RustPLC: scenario-doctor
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- scenario-doctor plc/main.plc --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --fix-preview --output human

tasks.label: RustPLC: sim-plc
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- sim-plc plc/main.plc --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --out out/sim/normal/trace.jsonl

tasks.label: RustPLC: no-board-gate
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- no-board-gate plc/main.plc --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --out-dir out/gate/no_board/normal --output human

tasks.label: RustPLC: gen-st
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- gen-st plc/main.plc --out out/codegen/st/main.st

tasks.label: RustPLC: build-rp2040
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- build-rp2040 plc/main.plc --out out/rp2040 --io-map config/io_map.toml
